sections.title: Three disciplines, *one accountable partner*
sections.intro: Most organisations buy software, AI and security from different suppliers who never speak to each other. We bring them together under one plan.

items.title: Digital Transformation
items.text: Replace spreadsheets, disconnected tools and ageing systems with software built around how your business really works.
items.label: Explore Digital Transformation

items.title: AI Solutions
items.text: Practical AI that saves hours, not hype that saves nothing. Voice agents that answer every call, AI agents that run routine work, and document AI that turns audio and paperwork into structured records.
items.label: Explore AI Solutions

items.title: Cyber Security
items.text: Find your security gaps, watch for attacks around the clock and prove compliance to customers, insurers and regulators.
items.label: Explore Cyber Security

sections.title: Technology should make growth easier, *not riskier*
paragraphs: Most organisations we meet have the same three problems. Work is stuck in manual steps and systems that do not talk to each other. AI has been talked about but not delivered. And every new system adds security and compliance risk that nobody fully owns.

AVRIX brings all three under one roof. We design and build the systems, add AI where it earns its place, and secure the whole estate, so you deal with one partner, one plan and one accountable contact.

items.title: Manual work
items.text: Processes stuck in spreadsheets, inboxes and systems that do not talk to each other.

items.title: AI not delivered
items.text: Plenty of talk about AI, but nothing running real work end to end.

items.title: Unowned risk

sections.title: Built, automated and secured *in one programme*

items.title: Modernise
items.text: We map how work really flows, then build or rebuild the platforms that run it.

items.title: Automate
items.text: We add AI agents, voice agents and document AI to remove repetitive work and speed up response times.

items.title: Secure
items.text: We test, monitor and harden what we build and what you already run, and give you the evidence to prove it.

items.title: Scale
items.text: When you need extra hands, our specialist engineers, AI and cyber professionals join your team.

sections.title: Real problems, solved for *real organisations*
sections.intro: Client names are kept confidential. Each project was planned, architected, built and delivered by the AVRIX team and our specialist partners.

sections.title: Need the people *as well as the plan*?
sections.text: When your project needs extra skills, we provide vetted software engineers, AI specialists and cyber security professionals who work as part of your team, from a single contractor to a full delivery squad. You get the capacity without the hiring delay.

items.title: One accountable partner
items.text: Software, AI and security under one contract and one named contact.

items.title: Right-sized and fixed-price
items.text: We scope to your budget and say when something is not worth doing.

items.title: Secure by design
items.text: Every system we build is tested and documented before it goes live.

items.title: UK and EU rules in-house
items.text: UK GDPR, EU GDPR, NIS2, DORA, Cyber Essentials and the EU AI Act.

items.title: We stay until it works
